Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) beautiful old wooden table
(B) old beautiful wooden table

The correct order is: Opinion (beautiful) -> Age (old) -> Material (wooden) -> Purpose (table). So, the correct answer is (A) beautiful old wooden table.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) delicious small Italian restaurant
(B) Italian delicious small restaurant

The correct order is: Opinion (delicious) -> Size (small) -> Origin (Italian) -> Purpose (restaurant). So, the correct answer is (A) delicious small Italian restaurant.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) wonderful large red square painting
(B) wonderful square red large painting

The correct order is: Opinion (wonderful) -> Size (large) -> Shape (square) -> Color (red). So, the correct answer is (A) wonderful large red square painting.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) old-fashioned small electronic white Japanese phone
(B) electronic white Japanese old-fashioned small phone

The correct order is: Purpose (electronic) -> Color (white) -> Origin (Japanese) -> Age (old-fashioned) -> Size (small). So, the correct answer is (A) old-fashioned small electronic white Japanese phone.
